title: Video: 5 Headlines You Missed Thursday Morning
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Thursday's opening bell :  

Xerox ( XRX ) is talking an array of deals with Fujifilm, though a full takeover of Xerox reportedly isn't on the table.  Bitcoin drops to its lowest levels of the new year as South Korea plans bill to close cryptocurrency exchanges. Top tech leaders, including the CEOs of Apple ( AAPL ) , Amazon ( AMZN ) and Facebook ( FB ) signed an open letter calling for DACA legislation. Investors expect earnings from Delta ( DAL ) .  U.S. stock futures traded higher despite President Trump's NAFTA warning.   Watch More with TheStreet :
